manifest.summary: Scans and parses TypeScript source files across a project directory using fast-glob and Tree-sitter. It builds Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) from TypeScript files to enable static code inspection and structural analysis. This serves as a foundational component for code understanding and extraction tasks.
capabilities: Locates TypeScript files across directories using glob patterns
Parses TypeScript source code into ASTs using Tree-sitter
Reads and handles local file system operations for code analysis

manifest.featureName: Codebase Dependency Analysis and Feature Slicing
manifest.summary: A static analysis suite that parses TypeScript and JavaScript codebases to build internal and external dependency graphs. It provides entry-point-driven dependency slicing using graph traversal to identify all reachable internal files and npm package dependencies required by a specific feature slice.
capabilities: AST-based import and export extraction using Tree-sitter for TypeScript
Repository-wide file scanning and metadata generation
Module resolution for internal relative imports and external npm packages
Dependency graph construction mapping file nodes and symbol edges
Transitive graph traversal (BFS) to extract isolated feature slices from a designated entry point

manifest.summary: Synthesizes structured semantic manifests from code slices using the Gemini API. Computes vector embeddings for feature manifests and persists them in a local catalog database. Enables natural language semantic search across indexed features using cosine similarity matching.
capabilities: Synthesize structured feature manifests from codebase slices using Gemini LLM
Generate text embeddings for feature manifests and search queries via Gemini Embedding API
Persist and load feature catalog records to and from disk
Perform cosine similarity search to retrieve relevant codebase features based on natural language queries

manifest.summary: Scans a codebase AST to construct module dependency graphs, detect entry points, and slice distinct feature subgraphs. It generates semantic feature manifests and stores vector embeddings in a searchable feature catalog.
capabilities: Repository AST scanning and dependency graph resolution
Domain entry point detection and slice deduplication
Feature subgraph isolation and analysis
Semantic feature manifest generation and vector catalog indexing

manifest.summary: Synthesizes semantic feature manifests from code slices using Gemini AI, computes text embeddings, and indexes them into a local catalog. Enables semantic search and similarity retrieval across indexed codebase features using cosine similarity.
capabilities: AI-powered feature manifest generation and runtime Zod validation
Vector embedding generation for code features via Gemini Embeddings API
Persistent local JSON database indexing for feature metadata and embeddings
Semantic search over feature catalog using vector cosine similarity

manifest.summary: Scans a target repository codebase to resolve module dependency graphs and detect domain entry points. Slices subgraphs into distinct features, generates semantic manifests, and builds a feature catalog stored in JSON.
capabilities: Repository AST scanning and dependency graph resolution
Domain entry point detection and feature subgraph slicing
Overlapping subgraph deduplication
Semantic feature manifest generation and indexing
